 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Conscientious"** means wishing to do one's work or duty well and thoroughly. (ईमानदार)
 
 
• **Example:** She is a conscientious worker, always ensuring that her tasks are completed to the highest standard.
 
 
 
• **"Conscientious"** refers to a person who is diligent and careful in their duties. (ईमानदार)
 
 
• **Example:** His conscientious approach to his studies has earned him top grades.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Conscientous** (गलत वर्तनी): This is a misspelling of "Conscientious".
 
 
• **Consencious** (गलत वर्तनी): This is a misspelling of "Conscientious".
 
 
• **Conscietious** (गलत वर्तनी): This is a misspelling of "Conscientious".
